data.body_html:
Imagine sipping chilled cava as the sun melts into the Mediterranean, the Sierra Blanca turning gold behind Marbella's skyline. A Marbella sunset cruise with champagne and tapas 2031 is the most elegant way to end a day on the Costa del Sol. Departing from Puerto Banús, you'll sail past the Golden Mile, watch the lights of La Concha flicker on, and enjoy a private evening with your group. The package includes a licensed skipper, sparkling wine, beer, soft drinks, and light Spanish snacks — all for a fixed price starting at €749 for two hours. No hidden costs, no shared tables. Just you, the sea, and the sunset.

Why choose a sunset cruise in Marbella?

Marbella's position on the Costa del Sol means sunsets that last for over an hour, with the sun setting behind the mountains rather than directly into the sea. From the deck of a motor yacht, you get an unobstructed view of the entire horizon. The air cools, the crowds thin, and the water turns glassy. It's the perfect time for photography, a proposal, or simply unwinding with friends. The 2031 season runs from April to October, with peak sunset times between 20:00 and 21:30 in summer.

Our boats for the sunset experience

We offer two boats specifically for this cruise, both departing from Puerto Banús:

  • Astondoa 40 — 12.5 metres, up to 9 passengers. A sleek Spanish-built motor yacht with a spacious aft deck and bow sunpad. Ideal for small groups wanting a cosy atmosphere.
  • Azimut 39 — 12.5 metres, up to 11 passengers. Italian design with a flybridge and a lower saloon. More space for moving around and taking photos.

Both boats come with a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, and all taxes included. The price for a 2-hour sunset cruise is €749, or you can book an 8-hour day charter for €2,299 if you want to add a swim stop or a longer route. For larger groups, consider our Mangusta 80 or Azimut 58 Flybridge — pricing on request via WhatsApp.

What's included in the champagne and tapas package?

Every charter includes:

  • Licensed English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the planned route
  • Unlimited water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light tapas-style snacks (olives, almonds, cured meats, cheeses, breadsticks)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21% VAT) — no surprise charges

You are welcome to bring your own champagne, wine, or extra food. There is no corkage fee. The crew will handle serving and clean-up.

Sample sunset itinerary

A typical 2-hour sunset cruise follows this route:

  • 18:30 — Board at Puerto Banús, welcome drink of cava.
  • 18:45 — Depart the marina, head west towards the Golden Mile.
  • 19:00 — Sail past Marbella's coastline, view La Concha from the sea.
  • 19:30 — Anchor near Cala del Faro for a short swim stop (optional).
  • 20:00 — Sunset toast with champagne and tapas as the sun dips behind the mountains.
  • 20:30 — Return to Puerto Banús, lights of the marina reflecting on the water.
  • 21:00 — Disembark.

For an 8-hour charter, you can extend the route to Estepona or Sotogrande, include a longer swim stop, or add a lunch break at a beach club. The skipper will tailor the plan to your wishes.

Best time for a sunset cruise in 2031

The sunset cruise operates from April to October. Sunset times in Marbella vary:

We recommend booking at least one week in advance during July and August, as sunset slots sell out quickly. The weather in Marbella is reliable, with over 320 sunny days per year, so cancellations due to rain are rare.

How to book your Marbella sunset cruise

Booking is straightforward. Visit our Boat Rental Marbella homepage, click on the sunset cruise experience, and send us a WhatsApp message with your preferred date, number of guests, and any special requests (e.g., dietary requirements, a proposal plan). We will confirm availability and send a secure payment link. A 50% deposit is required to hold the booking, with the balance due 48 hours before departure. We accept credit cards, bank transfers, and PayPal.

If you have a larger group or want a different boat, explore our full fleet or check out boat party options for a more lively evening.
